phase: Observed-world mechanism follow-up; fixed degree-matched support comparison
primary: Connected minus split full familiar-test generation accuracy at R2, 128k
analysis_unit: Average two paired initializations within each observed world; equal-weight mean of three world differences. Retain every pair and denominator.
limitations: Observed worlds; treatment changes contexts and higher-order pairings. Equal role counts do not match per-batch order or identify a unique graph mechanism.
